run_pipeline_safe: run StableDiffusionPipelineSafe to generate safe images from text prompts using Safe Latent Diffusion
configure_safety_guidance: configure SLD parameters like sld_guidance_scale, sld_threshold, and sld_warmup_steps for safety guidance
encode_prompt_safety: encode prompts with safety concept embeddings using the _encode_prompt method for classifier-free guidance
run_safety_checker: run the safety checker on generated images to detect and flag NSFW content
set_safety_concept: set a custom safety concept string to define what content the pipeline should avoid generating
